# CoachFlow

A premium two-sided marketplace connecting Sydney organizations with vetted basketball coaches. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, and featuring Apple-level design standards.

## Features

- 🏀 **Two-sided marketplace** for organizations and coaches
- ✅ **Verification system** for coaches (WWCC, insurance, first aid)
- 💼 **Organization dashboard** to post needs and manage applications
- 👨‍🏫 **Coach dashboard** with profile, availability, and job listings
- 💬 **Messaging system** for direct communication
- 🤖 **AI Assistant** (Beta) powered by Vercel AI SDK v5
- 🎨 **Premium glassmorphic design** with smooth animations
- 📱 **Fully responsive** across all devices

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- **UI Components**: shadcn/ui (Radix UI), Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth, Database, RLS)
- **AI**: Vercel AI SDK v5 (ready for GPT-5)
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ and npm
- Supabase account
- OpenAI API key (optional, for AI features)

## Setup Instructions

### 1. Clone and Install

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd coachflow
npm install
```

### 2. Set up Supabase

1. Create a new Supabase project at [supabase.com](https://supabase.com)
2. Go to Settings > API to find your project URL and anon key
3. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill in your Supabase credentials:

```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your_supabase_url_here
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your_supabase_anon_key_here
AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here # Optional
```

### 3. Set up Database Schema

Run the following SQL scripts in your Supabase SQL editor:

1. First, run the schema script:
```bash
# Copy contents of supabase/schema.sql and run in Supabase SQL editor
```

2. (Optional) Load demo data:
```bash
# Copy contents of supabase/seed.sql and run in Supabase SQL editor
```

Demo accounts (password: demo123):
- **Organizations:**
  - bondi.academy@demo.com
  - sydney.youth@demo.com
  - north.shore@demo.com
- **Coaches:**
  - sarah.coach@demo.com
  - mike.coach@demo.com
  - emma.coach@demo.com
  - james.coach@demo.com
- **Admin:**
  - admin@demo.com

### 4. Set up Authentication

In Supabase Dashboard:
1. Go to Authentication > Providers
2. Enable Email provider
3. Configure email templates as needed

### 5. Run Development Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to see the app.

## Project Structure

```
coachflow/
├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages
│   ├── auth/              # Authentication pages
│   ├── org/               # Organization portal
│   ├── coach/             # Coach portal
│   ├── admin/             # Admin panel
│   └── api/               # API routes
├── components/            # React components
│   └── ui/               # Reusable UI components
├── lib/                   # Utility functions
│   ├── supabase/         # Supabase clients
│   └── auth/             # Auth utilities
├── types/                 # TypeScript types
└── public/               # Static assets
```

## Key Features

### For Organizations
- Post coaching needs with detailed requirements
- Review coach applications and profiles
- Verify coach credentials (WWCC, insurance, etc.)
- Direct messaging with coaches
- Manage bookings and track history

### For Coaches
- Create professional profile with specialties
- Upload verification documents
- Set availability and travel preferences
- Browse and apply for opportunities
- Track application status

### Admin Features
- User management
- Listing moderation
- Analytics dashboard
- Platform health monitoring

## Database Schema

The app uses the following main tables:
- `users` - User accounts with roles (coach/org/admin)
- `coach_profiles` - Extended coach information
- `org_profiles` - Organization details
- `listings` - Job postings
- `applications` - Coach applications to listings
- `bookings` - Confirmed coaching sessions
- `messages` - Direct messaging
- `subscriptions` - Future subscription tracking

## Deployment

### Deploy to Vercel

1. Push your code to GitHub
2. Import project to Vercel
3. Add environment variables in Vercel dashboard
4. Deploy!

### Environment Variables for Production

Make sure to set these in your Vercel dashboard:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- `AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY` (when ready for AI features)

## Development Guidelines

### Code Style
- Use TypeScript for all new files
- Follow the existing component patterns
- Keep components small and focused
- Use server components where possible

### Design Principles
- Maintain Apple-level design quality
- Use glassmorphism effects consistently
- Keep animations smooth (200-300ms)
- Ensure AA+ accessibility standards

### Git Workflow
```bash
git checkout -b feature/your-feature
# Make changes
git commit -m "feat: add your feature"
git push origin feature/your-feature
# Create PR
```

## Future Enhancements

- [ ] Stripe integration for payments
- [ ] Calendar sync for bookings
- [ ] Mobile app (React Native)
- [ ] Advanced search filters
- [ ] Coach ratings and reviews
- [ ] Automated matching algorithm
- [ ] Email notifications
- [ ] SMS reminders

## Support

For questions or issues:
- Check existing issues on GitHub
- Contact support at support@coachflow.com
- Use the in-app AI assistant (when available)

## License

Copyright © 2024 CoachFlow. All rights reserved.
